faq.text: 🍿 | Hey, our bot is quite big, and there's a lot of information. Here are a few categories, choose which information you want to get >
faq.game_point:
🦕 In DinoGochi you become the owner of a unique dinosaur. Our game blends the atmosphere of a classic tamagotchi and RPG elements: you care for your pet, develop its skills, take part in adventures and competitions.

🎋 But DinoGochi is not only about caring. Your path is defined by you:
- You can focus on developing your dinosaur, training it and unlocking new abilities.
- Or engage in trading rare resources, building your own economy.
- Or perhaps you want to explore the world, participate in events, team up with other players or compete for the title of the strongest.

✨ DinoGochi is poble open sandbox where you choose your own playstyle.
 Grow, trade, explore, conquer — or simply enjoy life with your dinosaur.
faq.dino_mood:
🎈 *What is the dinosaur's mood?*
Mood reflects the dinosaur's overall state: how happy, satisfied, and eager it is for new adventures. Monitoring mood is important so the pet develops faster and is more effective on adventures.

🍎 *What affects the mood?*
Mood depends on your attention: play with the dinosaur, care for it, feed it favorite foods, and don't forget to interact. The more care you show - the better the mood!

👀 *Where to check the dinosaur's mood?*
You can see the current mood in your dinosaur's profile. We display it through special indicators and color labels.

💥 *What gives good or bad mood?*
With a good mood, the dinosaur gets useful bonuses: it develops faster, fights more successfully, and handles tasks easier. With a low mood, there may be nervous breakdowns: the dinosaur might refuse to follow commands or lose motivation.
faq.dino_height:
*🌱 What's up with the dinosaur's growth?*
Dinosaurs grow over 30 days after birth. However, each dinosaur is unique: some may grow into larger beings, while others remain small.
faq.kindergarten:
🏫 *What is a kindergarten?*
A kindergarten is a premium feature that allows you to send your dinosaur to a daycare for a few hours a day. During this time, caregivers take care of your pet, keeping it in a good mood.
faq.dino_skills:
🎯 *What are dinosaur skills?*
Skills are characteristics that directly affect your dinosaur's success in various activities. They are upgraded through training and unlock various bonuses.

🌟 *What bonuses do skills give?*
- With high charisma, there is a chance to cancel a bad mood.
- Agility reduces the time to complete tasks.
- Charisma gives a discount on progression.
- High charisma increases the chance to get extra experience in food gathering, games, travels, and sleep.
- When gathering resources, the chance to find rarer items increases.
- In games, the dinosaur receives an additional bonus with high charisma.
- With high intellect, there is a chance to create one extra item at once.

💪 *How to train skills?*
Skills can be trained by sending your dinosaur to training. Different trainings develop different skills!
faq.settings:
⚙️ *What can be configured in the game?*
In DinoGochi there are many settings to make the game even more convenient:

- Disable daily reward notifications.
- Adjust inventory page size.
- Rename the dinosaur.
- Customize the profile interface appearance.
- Delete account.
- Set how dinosaurs will call the owner.
- Choose the bot's language.
- Set permission to talk to the owner.
- Set nickname in the bot.
- Reset avatar.

All settings are available in a special menu section.
faq.friends:
🤝 *What are friends in DinoGochi?*
Friends allow interacting with other players and developing co‑operative gameplay. Features of friends:

- View a friend’s profile.
- Share coins and items.
- Hug together to raise dinosaurs.
- Change a friend’s name for convenience.
- Send dinosaurs to play together.

👥 *How to become friends?*
Add a friend via the special menu or with the `/add_me` command in a group.
faq.referal:
💎 *What is the referral system?*
The referral system allows you to earn bonuses by inviting friends to the game.

🤍 *How does the referral system work?*
After clicking the referral link, you immediately become friends with the inviting player.

💜 *What do I get when my friend reaches level 5?*
You receive a rare or unusual egg!

❤️ *What will my friend receive?*
The friend will receive the following bonuses: 255 coins, 🍯 Honey pot x2, 🍪 Cookies x2, 🧸 Stuffed bear, 🍗 Chicken leg x2, 🍒 Berries x2, 🦪 Small fish x2, 🎂 Cake
faq.market:
🏪 *What is the market?*
The market is a completely independent system for exchanging items and coins. Each player can set up their shop profile.

🖼️ *Can I set a profile picture on the market?*
Yes, if you have a subscription you can set your profile picture.

💸 *What exchanges are available on the market?*
The market offers the following exchanges:
- Exchange items for coins and vice versa.
- Exchange items for items.
- Item auction, where the highest bid wins.
faq.dino_tavern:
🍻 *What is the tavern?*
The tavern is a place where you can get quests and hear exciting stories.

🎯 *What can you do in the tavern?*
- Get a quest that will give you additional tasks and bonuses.
- Hear interesting stories that may give hints for future adventures.
faq.events:
🎉 *What are events?*
Events are special events in the game that can appear both in the bot and as additional events.

🎮 *What kinds of events are there?*
- Bot events are temporary tasks and activities that appear for a certain period.
- Additional events may include bonuses, new mechanics, or unique items that are available for a limited time.
faq.donate:
💖 *Where do donations go?*
Funds received from players go to the following needs:

- Hosting payment to keep the bot running stably.
- Advertising to attract new players.
- Rewards for the work of people who develop the bot.
- A little on snacks to keep the team motivated.
faq.super_coins:
💎 *What are super coins?*
Super coins — are a special currency that can be obtained by watching ads or via donation.

🎁 *What can you buy with super coins?*
Super coins can be spent on special items available via the `/super` command
faq.more_dinos:
🐾 *How to get more dinosaurs?*
The number of dinosaurs you can keep depends on your level and subscription:

- Every 20th level gives +1 slot for a dinosaur.
- With a premium subscription you get +1 slot.
- Also, there is always 1 slot available for a joint dinosaur.
faq.craft:
⚒️ *What is crafting?*
Crafting is the process of creating items using recipes and materials. Some recipes require time to create.

📝 *Where to find recipes?*
Recipes can be found at the market, from the junk dealer, or during an expedition.
faq.breakdown:
😣 *What is a nervous breakdown for a dinosaur?*
A nervous breakdown is a state that can occur if the dinosaur is in a very bad mood.

⚠️ *How to prevent a nervous breakdown?*
To prevent a nervous breakdown, raise the dinosaur’s mood by giving it attention, feeding it, or performing other actions. If it doesn’t work immediately, just wait and the mood will improve over time.
faq.general:
🎈 *Rarities*
Events and dinosaurs are classified by rarity.
The rarer the item, the sweeter the reward.

 1. Common - 50%
 2. Uncommon - 25%
 3. Rare - 15%
 4. Mythic - 9%
 5. Legendary - 1%

🕹 *Interactions*
To interact with a dinosaur, go to `🕹 Actions`.

 1. To feed the dinosaur you need to gather food, tap on `🕹 Actions` > `🍕 Food Gathering` and follow the instructions.

 2. To feed the dinosaur tap on `🕹 Actions` > `🍣 Feed` and choose suitable food.

 3. In `🎮 Entertainment` you can pick a game to entertain the dinosaur and lift its mood.

 4. In `🎑 Travel` you can find various items, meet friends and see a lot of interesting things!

 5. `🌙 Put to Sleep` the dinosaur needs sleep daily, don’t forget to put it to bed!

🎮 *Profile*
To view inventory or check your stats, go to `👁‍🗨 Profile`
faq.eat:
🥙 *What does my dinosaur eat?*
Look at your dinosaur's profile, dinosaurs live in their natural habitat.

Herbivores live where there is a lot of grass, predators live in forests / jungles, and those who love fish fly in the clouds.

🍕 *Snacks*
🍯 A jar of honey, 🥞 Sweet pancakes - dinosaurs love snacks and regardless of their type, they will gladly eat them!

This food also gives bonuses to mood / health and etc.

You can find all information about the item in the inventory!
faq.accessories:
🏓 *Accessories*
Accessories open additional opportunities or speed up the type of activity.
Accessories can be installed while the dinosaur is doing nothing, using it in the inventory.
Accessories can be found in travels or in the dungeon.

🎲 *Here are some of them...*
 🧸 Teddy bear - allows you to choose sleep mode.
 🛠 Tools - speed up food gathering.
faq.runes:
🔮 *Runes of Enhancement*

Runes are used in the forge to influence the result of item enhancement:

1. *Confidence Rune (Type 1)*: Guarantees 100% chance of a successful enhancement up to a certain level. For example, a Level 3 Rune guarantees success for enhancements on levels +1, +2, +3.
2. *Luck Rune (Type 2)*: Adds a fixed percentage to the base enhancement chance (e.g., +10% or +25%).

Use the /blacksmith command to go to the blacksmith menu.

Ancient and mighty forest with gigantic trees, Hasanows as they say about this forest...
I, Frederick Al Johnson, will verify it myself!
26.08.3--7 15:38: I just entered the forest; at a glance it looks like just a forest, except for huge trees!

26.08.3--7 19:12: Saw a beautiful sunset, went looking for a place to rest.

26.08.2--7  Updated 21:01: All day I saw no dangerous animals, only trees, trees, trees.

27.08.3--7 Updated: I somewhere lost my watch, cannot write time now, but it's getting dark.

27.08.3--7: I cannot believe myadies, whatেশ… Dinosaurs? I’m surely not losing my mind?
Writing fast, seems one of them sensed me, I’m about to get swept away.

28.08 +- 2 days: I don't know how long I've been sitting here, someone keeps walking over me, I haven't replenished water and food supplies for a long time, soon I'll have to decide. I'm not sure I can withstand the DINOSAURS (YES IT'S DEFINITELY THEM!)
I'll leave it lying here, I hope I return here.
book_lost-islands: It's me Aot again. Today Propane told me about ancient ruins on the island and we are heading there.

When we went ashore it got hot and we went swimming.

After that, walking along the shore we noticed the ruins of an old temple among the palms.

Upon entering we were amazed by the grandeur of the ancient structure. Columns stood everywhere, bas-reliefs were carved into the walls.

After inspecting the temple we found 300 coins!

Propan suddenly tripped over something and lay on the ground. I looked at it. It turned out to be a book.

Shortly later we inspected a few more temples, found a cake and 3 mushrooms.

We fell asleep on the sand.

And by morning we were back home.
book_desert: Who doesn't know about the mysterious pyramids, sand dunes, and poisonous snakes?

This short story is from my perspective about why it's worth it, and sometimes you shouldn't go into the desert where dinosaurs roam.

So let's begin.

Stocked with supplies, I set out to explore the desert.

The first day went ideally... except for the fact that the sun blazed mercilessly.

I found 50 square coins, how did they get here?

The next day I reached the pyramid. It appears I am not the only one.

A huge dinosaur stood about 20 meters from me. He pushed a wall and entered; I waited 5 minutes, then entered as well. The pyramid was huge, filled with mazes and passages.

I will not fully describe the pyramid, as it would take a long time.

็งI'll just say that I found a parchment depicting a backpack and strange symbols.

I fell asleep right inside the pyramid.
The next morning I woke up feeling like someone was watching me. I opened my eyes and saw... a dinosaur! He stood straight in front of me, studying me, head slightly tilted.

And then the dinosaur spoke up. He said to me: "Hello!"
- "Hello," I replied.
- What's your name?
- Aut.
- Should we be friends?
- Yeah, let's.
- But I'll call you the messenger of darkness, because I don't know how you appeared here.
So we became friends with the dinosaur.
book_mountains: Hi, it's me again, Aut. Today me and Praspatch are going on a trip to the mountains.

Crystal mountains... How pretty... And cold. Brrbrbr.

While walking on snow, Praspatch suddenly fell into a snowdrift. He got out. And fell again. Then he recounted his coins, took the square one and flung it into the snow.

After an hour, snow started falling and the dinosaur got upset.

When we were sitting by the fire, a white bear approached us. Propane hit it in the side with its hind paw. The bear flew a couple of meters, but still managed to catch the dinosaur.

The next day we found an egg. It was shimmering. Here it is white. Now it's green. In a moment it turned blue. Now it's lilac. Orange. And white again.

 We continued our journey.

Propane bent down and picked up a sheet of parchment.

This is a cake recipe, - he explained - I love cakes.

 And suddenly a snowstorm began.

We found ourselves in a forest of strange trees, and between the trunks our house could be seen.

 We sat down to drink tea.

arm_wrestling.text: You encountered a large dinosaur that offers to test your strength in an arm wrestling match for fun. Ready to risk it?

outcomes.success: You defeated your opponent by strength and received a reward!
outcomes.fail: You lost and strained your paw muscles, while the opponent left.

outcomes.success: You politely declined and continued on your path.

boulder_lift.name: Heavy Boulder
boulder_lift.text: A huge boulder blocks the path to a small treasure. Try lifting it?

outcomes.success: You lifted the boulder and collected the treasure!
outcomes.fail: The boulder was too heavy, and you wasted your strength recklessly.

outcomes.success: You decided to bypass the boulder.

broken_bridge.name: Old Bridge
broken_bridge.text: Before you is a deep ravine with a broken rope bridge. Try jumping over?

outcomes.success: The dinosaur jumped the ravine gracefully and found a valuable item on the other side!
outcomes.fail: The dinosaur fell and crashed into the rocks but managed to climb out.

outcomes.success: You took time and found a safe alternate route.

steep_climb.name: Steep Cliff
steep_climb.text: At the top of a steep cliff, something shiny catches your eye. Try climbing up?

outcomes.success: You successfully climbed the cliff and found a hidden treasure!
outcomes.fail: You slipped from the height and got hurt.

outcomes.success: You decided not to take the risk and continued on.

ancient_runic_puzzle.name: Ancient Runic Puzzle
ancient_runic_puzzle.text: On the ancient gates, an intricate pattern of glowing runes is carved. Attempt to solve it?

outcomes.success: Your dinosaur solved the logic of the pattern, and the gates opened, revealing a valuable rune!
outcomes.fail: The puzzle was too difficult, and the runes faded.

outcomes.success: You continued on.

poisonous_flower.name: Mysterious Flower
poisonous_flower.text: You found an unusual glowing flower. Attempt to eat it?

outcomes.success: Your dinosaur correctly identified the healing properties of the flower. It restored health and hunger!
outcomes.fail: The flower turned out to be poisonous! Your dinosaur fell ill.

outcomes.success: You passed it by.

trader_haggle.name: Nomadic Trader
trader_haggle.text: A wandering trader offers to buy valuable coins but is lowering the price. Attempt to haggle?

outcomes.success: Thanks to your charm, the merchant gave in and gave you an excellent discount!
outcomes.fail: The merchant got angry at your attempts to lower the price and took some of your money for the inconvenience.

outcomes.success: You bought the item without a discount.

beast_tame.name: Wild beast
beast_tame.text: A large wounded predator is growling in front of you. Try to tame it?

outcomes.success: You calmed the beast with a lick, and it brought you gold coins from its burrow!
outcomes.fail: The beast became even more angry and bit your dinosaur!

outcomes.success: You prepared for defense, and the beast backed off.

archery_contest.name: Archery Contest
archery_contest.text: Local hunters are holding a competition for shooting at targets. Join in?

outcomes.success: You showed phenomenal accuracy and won the grand prize!
outcomes.fail: Your shots went past, and the hunters laughed at you.

outcomes.success: You declined to participate.

weightlifting.name: Powerlifting Triathlon
weightlifting.text: In the mercenary camp, you are offered to lift a huge metallic shell. Will you dare?

outcomes.success: You lifted the shell under the applause of spectators and won a reward!
outcomes.fail: You hurt your back and wasted energy needlessly.

outcomes.success: You walked past.

riddle_sphinx.name: Riddle of the Sphinx
riddle_sphinx.text: A huge stone Sphinx blocks the path. It will ask you a riddle if you agree.

outcomes.success: You gave the correct answer! The Sphinx let you pass and rewarded you with gold.
outcomes.fail: Wrong answer! The Sphinx trapped your dinosaur in despair.

outcomes.success: You ran away timidly.

music_performance.name: Ancient Instrument
music_performance.text: You found a stone altar with a flute. Will you try to play a beautiful melody?

outcomes.success: The music awakened the ancient magic of the altar, restoring the group's strength!
outcomes.fail: Your play sounded fake, causing only a headache for the dinosaur.

outcomes.success: You walked past.

maze_navigation.name: Confusing maze
maze_navigation.text: Before you is the entrance to an ancient labyrinth. Will you try to find the exit?

outcomes.success: Thanks to your wit, you quickly found the way to the exit and a chest of valuables!
outcomes.fail: You wandered in the darkness for a long time and emerged completely exhausted.

outcomes.success: You went around the labyrinth.

rope_balancing.name: Rope over the abyss
rope_balancing.text: The only way forward lies through a thin rope stretched over a deep chasm. Will you cross?

outcomes.success: You perfectly balanced and crossed the chasm, finding coins on the other side!
outcomes.fail: You lost your balance and fell down, sustaining serious injuries.

outcomes.success: You spent time to safely bypass the chasm.

heavy_gate_push.name: Locked gates
heavy_gate_push.text: Before you are locked iron gates of an abandoned storage. Try to break them?

outcomes.success: The gates gave way to your incredible strength! Inside you found an ancient relic.
outcomes.fail: The gates didn't budge at all, you just wasted a bunch of strength for nothing.

outcomes.success: You decided to leave.

beggar_dino.name: Lonely traveler
beggar_dino.text: By the fire sits a gloomy dinosaur. Try to negotiate with him for a night's lodging?

outcomes.success: He turned out to be hospitable and fed your group, letting you rest by the fire!
outcomes.fail: The traveler drove you away from his fire, you spent a cold night on your feet.

outcomes.success: You went further into the darkness.

artifact_appraisal.name: Ancient artifact
artifact_appraisal.text: On the floor you found a strange flickering device. Try to study its mechanism?

outcomes.success: You figured out the mechanism and extracted valuable coins from it!
outcomes.fail: The device exploded in your paws, slightly tiring your dinosaur.

outcomes.success: You decided not to touch the strange mechanism.

dodge_trap.name: Dart trap
dodge_trap.text: You heard the click of a slab under your paw. The trap triggered! Will you try to dodge?

outcomes.success: You reacted instantly and dodged! The darts flew past, and one knocked a bag of gold off the shelf!
outcomes.fail: The darts hit the dinosaur directly, dealing heavy damage.

outcomes.success: You froze, the darts flew past.

chest_pry.name: Chest in the thickets
chest_pry.text: You found an old chest tangled with strong roots. Try to tear the roots with your hands?

outcomes.success: You easily tore the roots and opened the chest, finding valuable materials!
outcomes.fail: The roots were too strong, and the dinosaur badly cut its paws.

outcomes.success: You walked past.

merchant_charm.name: Merchant's Charm
merchant_charm.text: You met a merchant who sells valuable supplies. Will you try to charm him to get a gift?

outcomes.success: The merchant was touched by your friendliness and gifted you a valuable item!
outcomes.fail: Your flattery seemed suspicious to the merchant, and he demanded payment for the conversation.

outcomes.success: You left.

sleeping_dino_steal.name: Sleeping Dinosaur
sleeping_dino_steal.text: You encounter a sleeping dinosaur with a full bag of items nearby. Will you try to steal the items or wake it up and help?

outcomes.success: You successfully stole the items! However, the dinosaur woke up later and started searching for thieves. In the next battle, he'll fight on the enemy side!
outcomes.fail: The dinosaur instantly woke up from the noise and immediately attacked you!

outcomes.success: You woke it up and helped get it ready to go. Grateful, the dinosaur decides to help you in the next battle!
outcomes.fail: You woke it up, but it muttered something incoherent and left.

tsuhaa_paladin.name: Paladin Tsuhaa
tsuhaa_paladin.text: You encounter the powerful Paladin Tsuhaa. Ask him to help you on your journey?

outcomes.success: The Knight Tsuha agreed to join your group for the next battle!
outcomes.fail: Paladin Tsuha is busy hunting bugs, but he blessed you, restoring health and energy!

outcomes.success: You politely nodded and walked past.

string_to_str.info:
⚽ In some teams it's convenient to specify time not as a number, but as text, here's a cheat sheet.

If you were sent here, it means you can use text-based time input methods. You can try it right here, type `/string_to_sec` `1d` `1h` `12m`
You will get 90720 as a response - this is the number of seconds calculated from your message.

What symbols can be used?
`w` - week, `d` - day, `h` - hour, `m` - minute, `s` - second (you can omit the letter)

_By the way, you can specify the same symbol as many times as you want and in any order._
